name: Med Reminder — Intelligent Health Companion
tagline: Never miss a dose again. Manage medications for you and your family with an intelligent reminder system featuring OCR label scanning and biometric security.
description:
Never miss a dose again. Manage medications for you and your family with our modern reminder system featuring OCR label scanning, drug interaction checking, and biometric security.

Health Intelligence

📅 Smart Scheduling

Easily add medications with specific dosages, frequencies, and recurring intervals. Handles everything from antibiotics to chronic prescriptions.

📷 OCR Label Scanning

Point your camera at the medication label. Our AI-driven OCR (Google ML Kit) extracts names and schedules automatically for error-free entry.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Profiles

Create separate profiles for children, parents, or elderly relatives. Monitor the entire family's adherence from a single dashboard.

🛡️ Biometric Security

Protect sensitive medical data with industry-standard biometric authentication (Fingerprint, Face Unlock, or PIN).

🚀 Patient Setup Guide

Step 1: Create Profile

Set up your primary profile. You can also add family members with custom icons for easy identification.

Step 2: Add Medications

Tap Add Medicine. Use the camera to scan the label or manually enter details using auto-complete.

Step 3: Configure Reminders

Set precise alarm times. Enable Post-Reboot Execution to ensure schedules are never interrupted by device restarts.

Step 4: Track & Adjust

Log doses as you take them. View the Adherence Log to see your progress and identify patterns over time.
